$comment: The core suite's reviewed platform lists (scripts/platform-tests.ts; paths relative to packages/core). linuxKnownFailures: Linux product bugs the Linux shards skip until their owner fixes them; a listed file that starts passing fails CI, so the list only shrinks, and a new Linux failure fails its shard until it is fixed or reviewed here. linuxSkips: Linux files whose tests may skip, each with why. darwinGateAllowed: Linux files that name darwin near a test gate without gating on it. windowsFiles: the core's session and turn-loop files the core-windows job runs (lane A), patterns relative to packages/core. windowsKnownFailures: Windows failures that job skips until their owner fixes them (owner, cause), checked the same way. windowsSkips: windowsFiles files whose tests may skip on Windows, each with why.

test/auth/credential-migration-lock.test.cause: I-A: a process's start time reads null on Linux (the test wants epoch seconds, as from sysctl and ps on macOS)

test/cowork/peer-inbox-sqlite.test.ts.cause: a failing rename of the scrubbed copy reports runtime-state.db corrupt on Linux instead of leaving the raw copy

test/e2e/mid-turn-fold-e2e.test.ts.cause: a steer to a running session folds twice, and TaskStop's cleared steer never closes the stopped turn on Linux

linuxSkips.src/agents/tests/windows-path.test.ts: an agent backend's bare command found as its .exe or .cmd on PATH: Windows only (the tree job runs it there)
linuxSkips.src/clock/tests/shared-clock.test.ts: one live SNTP query against the public servers runs only with CLOVER_LIVE_TIME=1, on every OS
linuxSkips.src/links/tests/daemon-sidecar.test.ts: needs the built clover-link sidecar: the link job builds it and runs this on Linux and macOS (it reads ps, so not on Windows)
linuxSkips.src/links/tests/sidecar.test.ts: needs the built clover-link sidecar: the link job builds it and runs these on Linux, Windows and macOS
linuxSkips.test/agent/browser-gates.test.ts: holds no tests on any OS: its gate walk retired with the engine (Task 17); the capability's sequence is pinned in test/capabilities
linuxSkips.test/agent/mcp/oauth-doors.test.ts: one drift guard runs only beside the linked SDK source, on every OS
linuxSkips.test/browser/headless-real.test.ts: the real headless shell runs only with CLOVER_HEADLESS_TESTS=1, which the machine job's Daemon · Headless browser test step sets, on every OS
linuxSkips.test/cowork/guest-runtime.test.ts: one test needs the candidate SDK's confined fixture, on every OS
linuxSkips.test/cowork/guided-reader-adapter.test.t: one opt-in drift guard against the SDK source, on every OS

linuxSkips.test/e2e/embedded-chat-dispatch-e2e.test: its Bash cases (bashTest) need the embedded runtime's sandbox, which is macOS-only until the agent SDK's Linux backend lands (lane A, bubblewrap); they skip elsewhere with lane K's inProcessSandboxReady()

linuxSkips.test/fence/spawn.test.ts: two tests need Windows hook shells (cmd and Git Bash); they run on the Windows tree job
